name: Narukami Island: Tenshukaku
description:
This is the dwelling of the Raiden Shogun, who rules over Inazuma.
It is also the perfect place for a "duel before the throne."

tabs.name: Memories: Duel to the Fiery Death I
tabs.description:
The Raiden Shogun's judgment has descended, and the Fatuus Signora shall trouble the Seven Nations no longer.
Yet the memories of climbing the steps of Tenshukaku and engaging her in a duel before the throne are still fresh in your mind.
Relive your memories of this duel, and you may learn something new.
